text:
RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 15

An all-female panel alone is not evidence of bias; panels typically reflect existing municipal leadership or HR staff. For senior director roles, qualifications like public consultation, political acuity, and leadership fit are often weighted more heavily than technical degrees or years in service. 

Raising sex discrimination without concrete evidence will likely damage your professional reputation across municipal networks. Furthermore, two weeks is a standard administrative turnaround time for municipal hiring feedback. Instead, send a polite follow-up requesting constructive feedback on your interview performance to help with future opportunities.
